data.value: Keep the edge entry after expanding a paper; when off, hide it while open.

data.name: TipHideEdgeCapsuleCloseButtonOnHover
data.value: Edge capsules still extend on hover; the extra area acts like the main capsule without a close button. Use Hide in the context menu to close it.

data.name: TipMaxTitleLength
data.value: Max characters shown in paper titles and capsules.

data.name: TipStartup
data.value: Start PaperTodo when Windows signs in.

data.name: TipHidePapersFromTaskbar
data.value: Expanded papers do not appear on the taskbar. Still reachable via tray, desktop papers, and capsules. Also forced on when “Hide papers from window switching” is on.

data.name: TipHidePapersFromWindowSwitcher
data.value: Hide expanded papers from Alt+Tab and Task View, and hide taskbar icons too. They remain reachable via the tray, desktop papers, and capsules. In this mode papers appear on every virtual desktop, so the Labs current-desktop wake feature is unavailable.

data.name: TipEnableToolTips
data.value: Brief hints when the pointer rests on buttons or interactive areas. Settings info icons always stay available.

data.name: TipEnableAnimations
data.value: Transition animations for common actions; off feels more immediate.

data.name: TipResizeGripMode
data.value: Paper resizing: Standard shows opaque bottom-right dots; Soft makes them about 50% transparent; Hidden removes the dots and lets you resize from any edge or corner. Dot color keeps Windows light/dark contrast with a slight scheme tint. Shape is unchanged.

data.name: TipPersistentPowerShellProcess
data.value: !pf / !powerf use a persistent process for faster starts; variables and state may carry across scripts. Turning this off ends that process.

data.name: TipPreferPowerShell7
data.value: Prefer pwsh.exe (PowerShell 7); fall back to Windows PowerShell if missing. Scripts can also use !pwsh / !ps5.

data.name: TipHideScriptRunWindow
data.value: Hide the script run window. !p / !power wait for exit and capture errors; !pf / !powerf only submit to the persistent process.

data.name: TipAutoClearCompletedTodos
data.value: Checking a todo as done removes it from the paper; Undo can restore it.

data.name: TipAutoCompressLargeImages
data.value: Over 8 MB, or any side over 2048 px: try scaling to a 2048-px longest edge and re-encode. Cancel import if compression is unsafe, fails, stays over 8 MB, or does not shrink the file. Off: no compression; over 8 MB is rejected. Either way, any side over 4096 px is rejected.

data.name: SettingsHideLinkedPapersFromCapsules
data.value: Linked papers not shown as capsules

data.name: TipAdvancedSettingsMode
data.value: When on, shows advanced settings. When off, only hides those items; selected values stay unchanged.

data.name: SettingsLabsIntro
data.value: These features are experimental, and their behavior or options may change. Each feature runs independently and stops its related runtime state as soon as it is turned off.

data.name: TipLabsEdgeCapsuleHoverPreview
data.value: Controls whether edge capsules can expand into previews on hover. Turning it off closes the current preview immediately without changing click, drag, or capsule behavior.

data.name: TipLabsEdgeCapsuleHoverIntent
data.value: Uses pointer speed, direction, and braking to delay or suppress previews during a fast pass. Once open, empty space inside the capsule queue's bounding rectangle stays open only while the trajectory clearly heads toward a browsable capsule; otherwise it closes after about 0.2–0.8 seconds according to sensitivity. Leaving that rectangle closes immediately. When off, the first preview opens immediately, later transfers use a fixed 50 ms stability wait, and empty space is retained for a fixed 1 second without direction analysis.

data.name: TipLabsEdgeCapsuleHoverIntentSensitivity
data.value: Five levels from Very low to Very high. Lower levels require a clearer stop and retain empty corridor space longer; higher levels open more readily and release no-target space sooner. Medium remains the recommended balance.

data.name: LabsCollapsePaperOnDeactivate
data.value: Collapse paper when focus is lost

data.name: TipLabsCollapsePaperOnDeactivate
data.value: Collapses an unfocused paper into a capsule. It does not trigger during dragging, title editing, or while a menu or drop-down is open. Capsule mode is required.

data.name: TipLabsInactivePaperOpacity
data.value: Only affects expanded, inactive papers. Activating a paper restores full opacity immediately.

data.name: TipLabsRestingCapsuleOpacity
data.value: Only affects ordinary and edge capsules while resting. Hovering, activating, or dragging restores full opacity; the master capsule is unchanged.

data.name: TipLabsCapsuleMagnetism
data.value: Dragging an ordinary capsule shows its snap destination. Release near a screen or application-window edge to attach and follow it. With window binding also enabled, opening a window-attached capsule keeps it bound to that window. This only affects capsules outside edge queues; dragging again, losing the target, or turning the feature off detaches it.

data.name: LabsCapsuleMagnetEdgeModeNotice
data.value: Edge capsules are currently enabled, so collapsed papers enter an edge queue instead of ordinary capsule magnetism. Turn off edge capsules in General settings to use this feature.

data.name: TipLabsWindowTethering
data.value: On an expanded paper, drag the window-binding button in the title bar onto another application window. Todo and note papers can both bind, follow the target, and restore any reserved edge-capsule slot after unbinding.

data.name: LabsEnableTetherVisibility
data.value: Retract when the target is hidden

data.name: TipLabsTetherVisibility
data.value: When the target is minimized or hidden, its bound paper is temporarily hidden or replaced by a separate capsule. Restoring or activating the target shows the paper again without changing the paper's own expanded, capsule, or visibility data.
